Eg_definition: For the consolidated pressure spectra the task source field is gap_eV; for BaSnTi optical-final spectra it is optical_eigenval_gap_eV. Both are set from EIGENVAL global sampled-k CBM minus global sampled-k VBM. The minimum same-k vertical gap is calculated and stored as min_vertical_gap_eV, separate from Eg. No optical-onset fit/threshold is used to define Eg.
relative_energy_definition: relative_energy_eV = photon energy energy_eV minus each spectrum task Eg; paired spectra are interpolated onto the common grid, and Figure S5 uses the 0 to 0.3 eV window.
